source: make a clicker game where you tap for clicks and I want a VERY DETAILED map that I can walk around in, give me a button on my screen called adminenpanel that only I HAVE and make it so I can do events and give clicks, there is to be no labels around the map or on the ground and I want a rebirth button on my screen and rebirthing doubles how much you get per click

answers.ask: You asked for a very detailed map but did not say what it is - a city, a forest, an island, something else?
answers.answer: Make it a detailed modern city map, with streets, buildings, parks, and interior-style decorative detail but no labels placed around the map or on the ground.

answers.ask: How big should the walkable area be - a plaza, a neighbourhood, or a whole world?
answers.answer: Use a neighbourhood-sized walkable area so it feels detailed and explorable while staying focused for the clicker game.

config.prompt: make a clicker game where you tap for clicks and I want a VERY DETAILED map that I can walk around in, give me a button on my screen called adminenpanel that only I HAVE and make it so I can do events and give clicks, there is to be no labels around the map or on the ground and I want a rebirth button on my screen and rebirthing doubles how much you get per click
config.genre_evidence: “make a clicker game where you tap for clicks” and “rebirthing doubles how much you get per click” describe an incremental/idle clicking loop. The detailed walkable map is not given a separate gameplay purpose.

extras.text: A private admin panel button visible only to the owner, with controls to run events and grant clicks.
A screen rebirth button that doubles clicks earned per tap.

config.evidence: "a VERY DETAILED map that I can walk around in"; no personal plot, team plot, underground layers, or tiered training grounds are specified.
config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Simulation map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Shared Persistent World: No personal plot at all — one common world everybody operates in together.
